sites.leftOutIntro: Indezy looked at these boards and does not read them:

leftOut.LINKEDIN: its robots.txt and user agreement forbid crawling, and it answers with a CAPTCHA.
leftOut.HITECHPROS: missions are shown to paying members only; the public site shows counters.
leftOut.OPTEAMIS: freelance missions are inside its app, after sign-up; the public site lists its own permanent jobs.
leftOut.COMET: a matching service without a public list of missions.
leftOut.AMAZING_DEV: a matching service without a public list of missions.
leftOut.LOOKINGFORTECHS: now Sharebound: every mission page needs a LinkedIn sign-in.
leftOut.MON_CONSULTANT_INDEPENDANT: its list is drawn in the browser with no public source; Free-Work and Collective republish its missions.
leftOut.NEXORIS: a corporate site: its missions are LeGratin's, which the feed reads.
leftOut.CAPGEMINI_TALENTNET: Capgemini's freelance network: its missions show without signing in, but its data is closed to crawlers.
leftOut.HELLOWORK: it lists freelance offers among its jobs (filter on the Freelance contract), but it is closed to crawlers.
leftOut.MALT: create your profile: clients contact you with missions.
leftOut.FREELANCE_COM: register your profile: its consultants call you when a mission matches.
leftOut.WHEELOFWORK: register your profile: it proposes tech, engineering and interim management missions that match.
leftOut.CREMEDELACREME: join the community: missions are proposed to its members (its public mission pages stopped in December 2024).
leftOut.WELCOME_TO_THE_JUNGLE: jobs of every contract, mostly salaried: freelance ones cannot be told apart, and its lists are closed to crawlers.
leftOut.URBAN_LINKER: a recruitment firm whose open jobs are all CDI.
leftOut.BLUECODERS: a recruitment firm whose open jobs are CDI.
leftOut.UNLCK: a recruitment firm with CDI jobs only.
leftOut.KONEKT: a recruitment firm with no public job list.

meta.title: Indezy · Find the mission, win it at the right rate, then run it
meta.description: The workspace of French IT freelancers: the missions of the main freelance job boards, your pipeline from first contact to signature, then activity reports and Factur-X invoices.

hero.title: Find the mission, win it at the right rate, then run it.
hero.lead: Indezy gathers the freelance missions of the French job boards, follows each opportunity from first contact to signature, and once the mission is signed, writes its activity reports and its invoices.
hero.sceneLabel: An Indezy pipeline: opportunities in five stages, from first contact to accepted or declined, each with its role, client and daily rate.

feed.title: Every freelance mission in one feed
feed.text: Free-Work, Cherry Pick, LeHibou, Collective.work and a dozen more boards, read for you. Saved and suggested searches, how well each offer matches your profile and the market's rate, suspicious offers flagged, and any posting added from its link.

pipeline.title: A pipeline you can trust
pipeline.text: A Kanban board from first contact to signature, interview steps with their checklist, a calendar and a booking link for recruiters, and job-hunting seasons with their own figures.

network.title: Clients, ESNs and contacts
network.text: Who works where and with whom, org charts, the exchanges with each contact and the follow-ups due, and the sources that bring you missions.

reports.title: Activity reports, validated by link
reports.text: Each month's CRA filled in a few clicks, sent to the client or ESN, who approves it through a link without an account, and printed as PDF in their template.

invoices.title: Invoices and documents
invoices.text: Factur-X invoices and credit notes, the accountant's export, purchase orders followed day by day, and the compliance documents ESNs ask for, shared through one link.

dashboard.title: A dashboard to decide
dashboard.text: Which sources pay off, the skills in demand, your activity over the year, missions sorted by their monthly commute, and what a daily rate leaves you once contributions are paid.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.text: Your skills, target daily rate, city and availability: offers are scored against them.

network.title: Clients and sources
network.text: The ESNs and clients you work with, their contacts, and where your missions come from.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.text: Added by hand, from a link, or from the feed in one click.

pipeline.title: Pipeline and interviews
pipeline.text: Each stage, each interview and each follow-up, until the offer is signed.

reports.title: After signature
reports.text: Activity reports every month, then invoices and their payment.

yours.title: Only you see your workspace
yours.text: No one else reads your opportunities, clients or rates, and nothing is shown to advertisers.

export.title: Everything can be exported
export.text: Download all your data at any time, and take your opportunities and contacts back from a file.

links.title: You choose what you share
links.text: A public profile, a booking link or a document link show only what you pick, and each can be closed at once.

who.a: Freelancers in French tech, developers, architects, data, DevOps, project and product people, whether they work through ESNs, platforms or directly with clients.

sites.q: Which sites does the feed read?
sites.a: Free-Work, Collective.work, Cherry Pick, LeHibou, Yeets, WorkDispo, Next Mondays, Mindquest, Freelance-Informatique and about ten more French boards, freelance missions only. Any other posting can be added from its link.

data.a: You do. Your workspace is yours alone, and you can export all of it at any time, as a file you can bring back.

languages.a: Indezy is in French and English, and so are its activity reports, invoices and emails.

home.footer: The workspace of IT freelancers in France.

screens.title: A look inside
screens.note: Screens of a demo workspace: the freelancer, clients and offers are invented.
